style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This wool present ornament is designed for decorating the Christmas tree with a cozy and playful festive accent. The soft felted finish brings a warm look that contrasts nicely with glossy baubles and tinsel. Hand-stitched star details and bow shapes create a classic Christmas gift style. On the tree, the ornament stands out as a cute mini present that adds volume and texture among lights and garlands. The mixed red and cream tones blend easily with traditional and modern Christmas color schemes. Made of soft wool for a warm, textile appearance. Dimensions approximately 7 x 7 x 8 cm. Handmade design with stitched details and decorative bow. Equipped with a brown cotton hanger for easy suspension on branches. Suitable as indoor hanging decoration in the Christmas tree or on festive branches.
